extraction.Name: James Janis
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee and refused to accept it for some time, but finally took it on the advice of the Farmer and Superintendet, who told him that if he did not atke it and pay the taxes that the land would be sold to satisfy them
extraction.Buyer: mortgaged his land to the Anchor Bank, Merriman, Nebr. for $3350.00, giving a mortgage on the allotment of my wife as well as mine; sold his land to J. C. Cozad, Martin, So. Dak. he to pay the mortgage and taxes
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes and mortgage so he had to sell his land
extraction.Occupation/Income: he farms what he can, does common labor and anything else that he can do and that his income is about $400.00 per annum
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in poor health, suffering with stomach trouble; has a wife and five children to support, all in fair health; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since his patent in fee was issued; document number No. 710; Shannon County, South Dakota; sworn November 28, 1928 | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned. | TASK 5 BULK ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-29: Sonnet text-extraction captured the allotment number from the source page header but classified it in NOTES as a 'document number' / 'Document No.' / 'No. NNNN' instead of placing it in the structured Allotment number field. The hypothesis that these document/file references are actually allotment numbers was confirmed via BLM cross-reference (exemplars: Eugene Means 2249, Lucy Patton 6802). This patch corrects 48 records via bulk regex extraction from NOTES with user-supervised review of every HIGH-confidence proposal.
